method: The generator trims each field and collapses whitespace to single spaces, rejects unsupported control characters and enforces field-length limits. Production and scene are required; take is an integer from 1 through 999; the shoot date must be a real Gregorian calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Frame-rate and sound values come from fixed allowlists. Blank optional fields display an em dash. The downloadable 1200 by 675 SVG uses system monospace text, fits text size conservatively from string length and XML-escapes every user-entered value. The page formats identification artwork only: it does not record or process media, synchronize audio, create timecode, store entries or make network requests.
